The first file defines the canonical inclusion ℕ → ℕ∞↗ and its properties (embedding, order-preservation, non-surjectivity, double negation density of the extended inclusion). The second file defines the type ℕ∞↗ itself with its algebraic structure (zero, successor, predecessor, constructor, retract of Cantor space, order structure).
